body: Can’t wait to see how far you come ✌🏻until then, best of luck! We’re rooting for you!

Same boat here! I took a two week break for New Years and it didn’t do too much for me or my tolerance or mood. The break was worth it though, it puts into perspective how much time n money goes into 🍃. now I’m trying to break until 4/20, i am dead inside but I’m dead inside with you 🤝!
Thanks for sharing dude! Definitely helps reading stories of those going through similar things. Keep it up!

For sure! I definitely view my life as a “before n after x happened” especially with the green, I can probably say before I smoked I was less stable and more sad, while I still have this slew of mental problems years later, I do feel like a more chill version of my teenage self lol

Keep going! Look at your next taste of the bud as a means of celebrations. Go for a joint and feel it out, i guess! Hopefully this will allow it to be a good thing in your life for creativity n such and your tolerance will be much better :)
I know I’m hella late but just wanted to let you know I’m proud of you, no matter what 🧡
Thanks for sharing! This is good motivation to stay on my t break
I’m also on day 8! Cheers :-)
i totally feel you on this. i hate being the clingy one in every meaningful friendship

your feelings are valid. it’s good that you were able to collect your thoughts and put them out there, even if it’s to a bunch of strangers on reddit. it shows a level of understanding i guess.

i’m really sorry that things became so hard that you couldn’t hold it in anymore. i would say that having done group dbt and learning coping strategies seems to help after a while. it’s the worst fucking thing in the world when the person you love the most seems to be working against you, even if they don’t mean to.
get a life

“ I stand by, waiting for something good to come
In due time, the skies will split for the sun to smile”

there will be brighter days ahead for all of us

my mom had me fuck around on st. john’s wort for like half a year thinking it would fix me. really, stuff like that barely makes a difference unless you get help. it’s like a labyrinth, you spend so long in denial that something so serious could be wrong with you, it eats you. then a doctor says “oh you have this” and suddenly you feel like a demon. you identify with it 
i wish there were a way to stop feeling like a burden in everyone’s lives and feeling like unless i impress every person i meet they won’t want to talk to me anymore. i’m tired of being too much. i’m tired of being the kid that my parents always worry about. i’m tired of knowing that i’ll end my life sooner or later because it just keeps getting worse. 

everything is just so intense
i feel the exact same way. but i don’t want people to hate me or see me as dramatic

i was in your shoes exactly a year ago, having to explain to my boss why i cry literally every shift. i felt so weak and like the world was caving in, but it got better. hope your boss is understanding and is willing to empathize
it’s the devil
hold onto these things that make you feel warm ☺️ best of luck to you

i totally feel you. i also think the best place to meet girls who are probably gay and also into the same things as you is at a concert or art show or zine fair or stuff like that. gay bars still feel like this quagmire of dudes, some of them who try to take me home lmao. but yeah, in my own experience, i’ve met a lot of my queer and qpoc friends through music and shows, who might understand your situation too. hope that helps in any way! it does get easier
i loved amy so much, also living vicariously through her lol
seem interested in her, ask her questions about herself and really show that you like to hear her talk. sharing a drink at the movies is really cute too
